purpose: Offline Home design review illustrations only. Not Unity runtime assets, not approved designs.

requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated navigation illustration for a Russian fairy-tale mobile game Home design review.
Input image 1 is ONLY a material and rendering reference: its approved carved antique-gold ornament, dark navy lacquer, sapphire palette, painterly polished detail. Do not reproduce the logo, lettering, crest silhouette, castles, or any existing logo elements.
Primary request: One crimson embroidered event banner suspended from a short horizontal carved dark-wood staff with small antique-gold finials, seen almost straight on. Rich but restrained dark-crimson fabric hangs with a shallow swallowtail point, gold embroidered border and one bold antique-gold sun/compass emblem centered on the fabric. Clear compact readable silhouette appropriate to a small navigation icon. Golden embroidery and aged wood should belong naturally to the reference artwork's detailed Russian fairy-tale family.
Composition: a single complete object centered within a square 1024 x 1024 image; generous transparent padding on every edge; fill roughly 70 percent of the image area. Warm top-left highlights, controlled dark shadows, clean edge separation. No pedestal, floor, atmosphere, or cast shadow outside the object.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha background, no flat background, no checkerboard drawn into pixels. Preserve transparent negative space around the staff and fabric.
Constraints: No text, letters, numbers, badges, UI button surrounds, circular frame, scenery, people, extra props, brand marks, watermarks. Do not create a vector symbol, flat generic icon, plastic render, or alternate logo.
requests.status: Selected for offline review; RGBA header verified. Actual padding narrower than requested, almost full-width staff.
